evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of fatigue in the setting of a strong family history of
early heart disease.

Findings: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes at 65 bpm. Normal axis.
PR interval 157 ms, QRS 83 ms, QTc 422 ms.
Impression: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes and no acute changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
55%. Trace mitral regurgitation. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Nrmal left ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
TotaI Cholesterol: 256 mg/dL (H)
LDL Cholcsterol: 180 mg/dL (H)
HDL Cholesterol: 51 mg/dL
Triglycerides: 125 mg/dL

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 143 mmol/L
Potassium: 4.5 mmol/L
Chloride: 98 mmol/L
CO2: 23 mmol/L
BUN: 16 mg/dL
Creatinine: 1.5 mg/dL (H)
Glucose: 126 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 9.3 mg/dL

Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Levothyroxine 75 mcg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: comfortable at rest.
Neck: supple, no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: cler bilaterally.
Extremities: no peripheral edema.
